source: National Property Information Centre (NAPIC), JPPH — Open Transaction Data (napic.jpph.gov.my/en/open-sales-data)
outlier_rule: step 1: psf_rm < 50; step 2: in schemes with 5+ sales left after step 1, psf below 0.4x or above 2.5x that scheme median psf (computed after step 1)

scheme_splits.THE ORION: split by psf at RM1,000 into THE ORION (JALAN TUN RAZAK) and THE ORION (NEWER HIGH-RISE, 2024 TRANSFERS)

note: Recent months incomplete: sales appear only after stamping. Area is NAPIC parcel area.
